text:
sam: Thanks for the all-hands — quick followups on the infra notes. Two things: what's the plan for APAC GPU shortfalls this quarter? And how will the autoscaler pick fallback models when preferred SKUs are scarce?
jordan: Good Q. Short version: prioritize region-local capacity, then cross-region burst to nearest healthy zone, then fallback to lower-SLO model variants. Will share runbook links.
maya: Adding detail — for APAC specifically, we expect constrained A100 supply until late Q3. We'll open a dedicated burst pool in SG and JP with mixed V100/T4 for non-latency-critical workloads. Latency-sensitive tiers get routed to AUS/US as last resort.
dinesh: Important note: routing priority is policy-driven. Current policy = [latency_slo, cost_tier, customer_tier]. We may adjust order for enterprise customers.
anya: For product teams: if you need strict regional isolation we can provision dedicated capacity; ping me and @sales to start.
lucy: On autoscaler behavior: it currently prefers same-model/quantization families. If capacity < threshold, it tries model_variant fallback chain, then cross-region. Example policy snippet:
```json
{"policy": "latency_first", "fallback_chain": ["redwood-llama-q4f","redwood-llama-q8_4","redwood-llama-small"]}
```
We can expose this as a per-route override.
sam: How is cache continuity handled on fallback — won't user sessions break if model changes mid-stream?
dinesh: We do a graceful handoff: keep KV cache for compatible archs; otherwise we flush and issue a short warning event to the SDK. SDK libs will handle retry/resume.
maya: Action: infra to publish "fallback behavior" doc and a checklist for product teams by EOD Friday. CC @sam @anya
infra-bot: deploy 2160-prod-autoscaler-policy applied to canary (3 nodes) :rocket:
sam: thanks — one more: any estimated cost impact when falling back to cross-region routing? ballpark numbers?
maya: Ballpark: cross-region adds ~15–40% per-token egress + latency tax. We'll provide per-customer estimate via billing preview.
anya: We'll update the rollout checklist and notify impacted customers before any forced cross-region shift.
sam: Great — appreciate it. If you post the runbook here I can loop in two customers who asked.
jordan: Will post links in #announcements and pin them. Thx everyone. :thumbsup:
